title: Jesus... Why Do My Parents Only Fight When They Think I'm Asleep?

bible.text: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why do my parents only fight when they think I'm asleep? 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I lie there with my earphones in, but there's no music playing. I'm just listening.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're listening because you're trying to protect everyone. That's a lot to carry at night.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: If I was a better son, maybe they wouldn't be so stressed all the time.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Their fight is not your fault. You didn't start it, and it's not your job to end it.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But what if one day one of them just packs a bag and leaves?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I can't promise every night will be quiet. I can promise you won't face any of it alone. Give Me the part you can't fix.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Tonight, put the music on for real. Let Me keep watch for a while.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What helps you sleep when home doesn't feel peaceful? 🙏
